customManagers.description: Update deps annotated with a trailing `# renovate: datasource=X depName=Y [versioning=Z] [registryUrl=…]` comment on the same line as the version. versioning defaults to the datasource's default. Whitespace is `[ \t]`, not `\s`, so a match can never span lines and pair a version with the next line's annotation. arg0 = file pattern.
